text:
amelia: Quick note  Mateo's birthday is next Tue. Thinking of either a low-key desk cookie tray in-office + Zoom toast, or a postcard chain where everyone signs and remote folks mail one card. Which do people prefer? :cookie: :postal_horn:
ryan: cookies + toast for the win. simple and tasty.
tess: love postcard chain idea for the long-term keepsake. both good.
people-ops-bot: Poll posted: react to vote: :one: Cookies + Zoom toast  :two: Postcard chain  :three: Both (if budget allows)
emma: :two: postcard chain  i'll design a tiny card template. who wants to sign?
harry: :one: cookies. i'll bring allergy-friendly options.
amelia: we have $40 from team budget. if we pick postcards and need postage, we can collect extras. people-ops-bot: Team budget covers $40. Collection link: https://pay.example.com/mateo-bday (suggested $5)
ryan: RSVP yes to set-up at 11:45 to put out cookies.
emma: if postcard wins i can send a spreadsheet for addresses. remote folks will need mailing addresses by Mon noon.
people-ops-bot: Reminder set: "Mailing addresses due" Mon 12:00.
amelia: tiny ask: keep it secret  Mateo reads slack. also, can remote folks send 5-10s video clips? we'll play a montage at 12:05 during the toast.
harry: i'll contribute $10.
emma: i'll do the montage. send clips to my DM by Mon 3pm.
people-ops-bot: Poll closes Sun 8pm.
amelia: final logistics: if cookies win, meet at Kitchen 11:45 to set up. if postcards win, meet at 12:00 to sign cards. Whoever volunteers to drop postcards at post office please DM me.
ryan: happy to drop them if needed.
amelia: thanks team! :sparkles: (End of thread)
